cohort: The study participants were unvaccinated pregnant women in the City of Manila, the Philippines.
finding: COVID-19 infection appears correlated with higher risks of gestational hypertension, fetal growth restriction, maternal preterm births, fetal prematurity, and COVID-19-associated complications, with some association with gestational and neonatal complications but little association with poor maternal, pregnancy, and fetal outcomes.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was more frequently performed in infected patients, though the disease showed little association with poor maternal-fetal outcomes.
